skill_name: What is the latest trends in AI research?
workflow: The latest trends in AI research include neural networks, natural language processing, computer vision, robotics, and machine learning. Neural networks are being used to improve the accuracy and efficiency of deep learning models. Natural language processing is being used to develop applications such as voice assistants and chatbots that can understand and respond to human language. Computer vision is being used to create algorithms that can identify and process visuals or objects in an image. R
